examples.quote: The replay points to a shift in the age distribution of reproduction, but it does not identify a single proven cause of the food-dependent mixture pattern. For 48 same-age founders, lowering the reproductive threshold changed the food effect on the mixture population contrast by -7.67 individuals. This is exactly the sum of a -4.85 birth component and a -2.82 death component. Their separate 95% intervals, -10.84 to 1.15 for births and -8.73 to 3.09 for the sign-reversed death component, are wide. The two components should not be ranked as definitively more or less important from these estimates.
